DISCOVERY 610, NO APPEARANCES. TENTATIVE RULING ADOPTED: DEFENDANT'S MOTION TO COMPEL THE ATTENDANCE OF PLAINTIFF AT DEPOSITION IS GRANTED. PLAINTIFF IS ORDERED TO CONTACT COUNSEL FOR DEFENDANT TO SCHEDULE HER DEPOSITION AT A MUTUALLY CONVENIENT TIME. THE DEPOSITION IS TO BE COMPLETED WITHIN 30 DAYS OF NOTICE OF THIS ORDER. FAILURE TO APPEAR AND TO RESCHEDULE THE DEPOSITION WAS A MISUSE OF THE DISCOVERY PROCESS. MONETARY SANCTIONS IN THE AMOUNT OF $536.30 ARE TO BE PAID WITHIN 30 DAYS OF NOTICE OF THIS ORDER.
